_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil: no breaker in motion while heat stays short and stress/flow offsets the grind, so hold Disbelief until confirmed heat-up or unwind.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase, only flow snapshot, no contradiction of the coil
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 50-62, funding near flat, 30d momentum 50-65, no ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G through 65 with funding and momentum rising together (into Hope), or F&G under 47 on long-unwind flush (into Complacency)
